choices.name: Basement hunger
choices.description: Low sustained growl with slow uneven pulses; lurking anticipation.

choices.name: Empty cavern
choices.description: Hollow descending groan with broad vowel-like resonance.

choices.name: Teeth first
choices.description: Three clipped guttural urges, rising toward a final snarl.

choices.name: Ravenous inhale
choices.description: A rough inhaling swell followed by a short throaty release.

choices.name: Bottomless appetite
choices.description: Deep irregular rumble with a bubbling throat texture.

choices.name: Mouth opening
choices.description: A strained upward growl that expands into a large raspy roar.

choices.name: Splinter snap
choices.description: A dry hard bite followed by scattered brittle wood-like cracks.

choices.name: Beam crush
choices.description: A deeper compressing crunch with several staggered breaks.

choices.name: Ceramic bite
choices.description: Sharp hollow fracture with brief bright fragments.

choices.name: Basin crunch
choices.description: A heavier ceramic crack followed by a granular fragment cascade.

choices.name: Tin crumple
choices.description: Thin metallic buckling with a short rattle.

choices.name: Pipe bite
choices.description: Low metal deformation followed by a strained ringing crunch.

intent: Vocal alternatives are generic creature hunger, not separate attacks. Bite alternatives split by actual eaten material; no universal brittle shatter for every bite.
rhythm: Provisional finite vocals1.8–3s for lurking/anticipation; crunch.48–.85s at visible jaw closure/contact, not on telegraph start. Do not let cue length determine combat timing. No loops; final mechanical rhythm pending specialist input.
validation: All12 source/candidate hashes match; ffmpeg decodes, mono32kPCM16 duration/zeroendpoint checks pass. Generator syntax/120-column/hygiene pass. No listening or person imitation claimed.
publication: No commit/push; publication hold remains. Not part of playable108. Original files/recipe/brief/numbered candidates retained.
